groups.name: NASDAQ SETUP
groups.label: Mixed / Neutral
groups.explanation:
⚠️ Material bearish change. Treasury yields remain the main pressure point, with the 2Y at 4.883% and the 10Y at 5.083%. QQQ is +6.09% over five sessions and +4.29% versus its 20-day average. Brent is +0.16% at about $99.41, adding some inflation pressure.

The Nasdaq Setup is mixed/neutral (-8/100, 54% confidence, deteriorating ↓). The current balance is supportive options positioning on the supportive side versus elevated/rising Treasury yields, weaker intraday semiconductor leadership as the main headwind.

Near-term risk is concentrated in the 10Y yield is above the 5.05% headwind threshold at 5.083%, semiconductor leadership is lagging QQQ, Nasdaq breadth is weak. Improvement in these conditions would strengthen the setup; further deterioration would reduce conviction. Elevated consolidation risk is reducing conviction in the directional setup.
